name: 94402 · San Mateo, CA
findings: ZIP 94402 (San Mateo) has 146 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94402 (San Mateo) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 94402 (San Mateo) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 23 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
